entries.title: Tacks on the card
lines: Tacks have their own cell on the session page and on the share card, beside the jibes.
The map behind a track in the sessions list is always the dark one.
The feedback mail names the channel: release, beta or dev.
Help: what to do when a watch update does not arrive.
Best hour opens its window on the map and chart, like the other eight records.
Please open a session you tacked on and check the new cell against your afternoon.

entries.title: Pages read on the round glass
lines: Every page read against the round glass: the widest line in the middle, numbers larger, words smaller.
Turns is one row: clean, flew through, touchdown, fell in. Tacks and jibes get a row each.
Seven switches in the Connect IQ settings hide the pages you never read.
The pages after a save are the live pages.
Every turn is counted again when the wind axis locks, so the tack and jibe rows always add up.

entries.title: Tacks and jibes apart, dunks read right
lines: A Tacks and jibes page after Turns. Each count, with how many of them flew through.
It is in the large-text set too, one screen each.
The page names the wind axis it counts against.
A watch that re-anchors after a swim no longer reads the rest of the session as falls.

entries.title: The whole distance
lines: Sessions recorded with Garmin's own activity now show the full distance, as Garmin Connect does.
The watch's Smart Recording saves a point every few seconds. Those pauses were read as holes.
Foil share, flights and swims change on these sessions too. A fifth of the time had been missing.
Riding exactly back and forth no longer hides the wind. Tacks and jibes are told apart again.
Pump strokes from the fenix 5 Plus family are read now.
Engine 0.23.0 re-derives your library once.
Please open a session recorded with Garmin's own activity and compare the distance with Garmin Connect.

entries.title: Falls read the dunk
lines: Falls are read from the dunk, not from the day's average height.
A watch that re-anchors its altitude after a swim no longer turns your afternoon into falls.
Wrist-under marks on the map show the dunks and not the weather.
Every speed follows the Units setting now: the charts, the records table, the turn stories and the widgets.
Knots or km/h, once, everywhere.
Engine 0.22.0 re-derives your library once.
Please open your sessions from the fenix 5 family and tell us whether the falls now match your day.

entries.title: The watch says what time it was
lines: A direct session carries the watch's clock offset now. The first one landed an hour off.
Pair with the 0.9.14-dev5 watch app. Older streams still import, with the zone guessed.

entries.title: The answer goes to the build that asked
lines: Two CleanJibe builds on the watch: the phone answered the public one. Now it answers the sender.
Wind and map go to that build too from now on.
Please open the watch app once with this build on Settings → Garmin watch. The waiting pages should cross.

entries.title: The answer reaches the watch
lines: The phone's answer to each page is flat now. The nested one never left the phone.
Settings → Garmin watch shows whether each answer was sent.
Pair with the 0.9.14-dev4 watch app, then save one session with the app open.

entries.title: Every page as it lands
lines: Settings → Garmin watch shows each direct page as it lands, and the link probe row refreshes itself.
Pair it with the 0.9.14-dev3 watch app, which keeps trying while pages wait.
Please save one session with the app open and read the two rows.

entries.title: A refused stream is set aside
lines: A direct stream the import refuses is set aside once, not shown again at every launch.
A stream without a single position fix is refused. Wait for the watch's GPS before you start.
Please save one session with GPS locked and this build open on Settings → Garmin watch.

entries.title: The stream that said no FIT found
lines: A direct session from the watch imports now. Build 80 received it whole and then refused it at the door.
A stream the import refuses stays in the inbox for the next launch.
Please save one session on the watch with this build open on Settings → Garmin watch.

entries.title: The beta channel, with its own icon
lines: The first build of the **beta channel**.
It is the app that goes to the App Store, plus the doors still proving themselves.
GPX and TCX files, the Garmin export ZIP, Apple Health, the video export, grouping and filters, the Apple Watch app.
Settings → Beta lists them and has a *Request a feature* line.
The icon and the start screen wear a red **BETA** label.
This build and the App Store one are told apart at a glance.
The app follows your phone's **text size** everywhere, up to the largest accessibility sizes.
The dense tables stop growing where they would break.
**Feedback from every page**, with a footer on each.
Menu → Support & ideas opens the same mail.
The mail starts with three blanks for you and the facts below.
Settings → Beta → Send usage report mails counters kept on your phone.
Nothing leaves unless you send it.
Sessions group by month, year or spot and filter by source.
Strava shows the official *Connect with Strava* button.
An imported session links back with *View on Strava*.
The three recording classes are named before you import, and in Help.
Worth checking: the BETA icon on your home screen, and Settings → Display → Text Size at its largest.
Nothing should be cut off.

entries.title: The card from the watch
lines: A session that arrived as a summary card from the watch opens as what it is.
You get the card's numbers, and how the full recording follows.
It no longer says the file is damaged.
The Sessions list's first grouping reads *All* instead of *None*.
The start screen shows cleanjibe.org under the name.

entries.title: Nine more watches, and the shore
lines: Nine more watches.
**Venu 2, 2S, 2 Plus, 3 and 3S, vívoactive 5 and 6, Instinct 3 AMOLED 45 and 50 mm.**
That was 39 products in all when 0.9.10 shipped.
They pass the layout checks in the simulator.
They have **not been ridden on a real watch**.
If you have one, tell us how the pages look and whether the touch controls behave.
The live map page and the post-save Track page can draw the shore of your spot.
The shore is drawn under the trail.
The CleanJibe iPhone app sends it over Bluetooth.
Take Settings → Garmin watch → Send map to watch.
No firmware map view is involved.
The firmware's own map kills the app on a fenix 8.
A splash page with the mark on the first launch after an install or update.
A larger mark on the start page.

entries.title: A crash fix for the watch link
lines: The app no longer crashes when the Garmin sends it something.
A summary card, or an answer to a map push.
Builds 43 to 47 fell over the moment a message arrived from a watch.
That watch was running a CleanJibe beta build.
Worth checking: send a map to the watch, and finish a short recording on it.
The phone should stay up and the session should appear.

entries.title: You choose which maps the watch gets
lines: **Map for the watch** is a page now.
The two most-ridden spots by default, or up to two picks among your own spots.
*Where I am now* is one of the picks.
Settings → Garmin watch → Map for the watch.
The phone reads its own position **once per send**, only when you picked it.
It never reads your position in the background.
The tick asks for the permission where you can see it.
The automatic send at launch never prompts.

entries.title: The session list groups and narrows
lines: **Group by** None, Month, Year or Spot at the top of Sessions, newest group first.
A library of twenty or more opens grouped by month until you say otherwise.
A **filter** beside Import: one spot, one source, a date window.
The sources are intervals.icu, Strava, Apple Health, the Garmin watch and a file.
What is active shows as chips you can tap away.
The count line reads *3 of 41 sessions*.
Records and Trends keep reading the whole library on purpose.
The menu at the top left of Sessions, in the order a new rider needs it.
Getting started, Settings, Support, then What CleanJibe does and What the numbers mean.
The build number sits at the foot of that menu.
The welcome screen has a close button now.
**Something off? Send feedback** sits at the foot of every page.
On a session page the mail names the session by itself.
Connect Strava from Settings → Strava as well as from Import.
The full-screen map's legend no longer floats to the middle of the screen.
It used to float after a keyboard was used somewhere else.

entries.title: Two fixes from build 41
lines: **Send map to watch** now finds whichever CleanJibe build you have on the watch.
Release, public beta or dev, instead of assuming the release one.
*Failure_AppNotFound* is gone.
The turn page scrolls from anywhere again.
A vertical finger on a strip scrolls the page, a sideways one scrubs the playhead.
A tap places the playhead.
The small window words no longer overprint each other.

entries.title: The session video, and a wider way in
lines: **Export video:** a session becomes a short film.
The map draws itself along your track, and the numbers land.
It shares like any other clip.
Open a session → share → Export video.
**Send map to watch:** the phone draws the shore of your spot.
It pushes the shore to a Garmin running CleanJibe 0.9.10.
The live map then has ground under the breadcrumb.
Take Settings → Garmin watch.
**Imports take GPX and TCX** as well as FIT.
A Polar, Suunto or COROS session comes in through intervals.icu.
It also comes straight from the vendor's app through the share sheet.
Without a speed channel the speed records are estimated and marked uncertified.
**Import from Strava:** connect your account under Import and pick the sessions.
Positions only, so speed records are uncertified.
One connected rider at the time this build shipped.
*[Since 14 September: Strava lets a new app connect a limited number of riders.]*
Analysis engine 0.18.0: the pump rung now asks the minimum foil speed.
Every touchdown and fall says *why* it ended that way on the turn page.

entries.title: A clean jibe needs ten quiet seconds
lines: No touchdown, no swim and no dunked wrist in the ten seconds after the sweep.
The star, the clean count and CPH on the wrist now mean what the phone means.
cleanjibe.org means the same by them.
The clean-jibe buzz therefore arrives up to ten seconds after the turn.
The flew through, touched down and fell in verdicts are unchanged.
They still buzz at once.
